# Chunk 14: William Cooper's Mystery Babylon — Deep Read

**Source identification:** This chunk spans the "William Morgan Interview" trilogy (labeled Parts 20–22 in the series numbering, pages 163–175 of the transcript). The interviewee is a CAJI (Citizens Agency for Joint Intelligence) member pseudonymed "William Morgan" after the historical figure murdered (per Cooper) by Freemasons in 1826 for revealing lodge secrets. The guest claims to have risen from Entered Apprentice to 32nd Degree Scottish Rite (Southern Jurisdiction) in two years as a Cooper-directed infiltration.

---

## 1. SPECIFIC CHECKABLE CLAIMS

### A. Institutional/Organizational Claims

| # | Claim | Context | Verifiable? |
|---|-------|---------|-------------|
| 1 | Prince Hall Masonry is a separate, parallel system for Black members; Caucasians can visit Prince Hall lodges but Prince Hall members cannot sit in mainstream lodges | WC asks WM about Prince Hall reciprocity, p.163 | Partially — PH recognition varies by jurisdiction; the claim of total non-reciprocity is historically inaccurate for the 1990s (many mainstream Grand Lodges had recognized PH by then) |
| 2 | Every Grand Lodge in the US "has been granted a charter from the United States government to operate on its own and enforce its own laws" | WM, p.170 | **False** — Grand Lodges receive charters from other Grand Lodges or their own state-embedded origins, not from the federal government. No US federal chartering mechanism exists for fraternal orders |
| 3 | "If a police officer or any law enforcement officer walks into a lodge while in session, not only does he not have arrest power, but that lodge immediately closes" | WM, p.170 | **No legal basis** — no statute or case law supports this; lodges are private property but not sovereign territory |
| 4 | Knights of Malta (SMOM) have diplomatic immunity, "can bring goods in and out of this country without going through customs" | WM, p.171 | Partially true historically (SMOM is a sovereign entity under international law, issues passports), but individual members who are US citizens do not receive customs exemption or blanket criminal immunity |
| 5 | Southern Baptist Convention scheduled a meeting/convention "against the Freemasons" in Houston, June 15–17 of that year | WM, p.175 | Checkable — The SBC did pass anti-Masonic resolutions in the early 1990s (the 1992 annual meeting was in Indianapolis in June; the 1993 meeting was in Houston, June 15–17). Cooper is likely referencing the **1993 SBC annual meeting** |
| 6 | The ADL "under intense investigation now for spying upon agencies and departments of the United States government and police departments" | WC, p.173 | Partially checkable — The ADL's Fact-Finding Division was investigated by the San Francisco Police Department in 1992–93 (the "ADL spy scandal" involving Roy Bullock); this was real but narrower than Cooper frames it |

### B. People Claims

| # | Person | Claim | Context |
|---|--------|-------|---------|
| 7 | Albert Pike | Author of *Morals and Dogma*; "head of world Freemasonry for a while"; head of Scottish Rite (Southern Jurisdiction); established KKK and B'nai B'rith | WC, p.173 |
| 8 | Giuseppe Mazzini | 1805–1872, "Italian patriot," friend/correspondent of Pike | WM reads from a Masonic reference book, p.173 |
| 9 | Joseph Smith | "Absolutely and undeniably a Freemason" | WM reads from Masonic-published book, p.173 |
| 10 | Winston Churchill, Harry Truman, Joseph Stalin | All "33rd degree Freemasons" at Yalta | WC, p.173 |
| 11 | Ronald Reagan | "Made a Mason on sight" | WM, p.173 |
| 12 | George H.W. Bush | "Is a Mason" (stated as fact by WM) | WM, p.173 |
| 13 | Reverend Jim Shaw | 33rd-degree Freemason who witnessed another candidate profess support for "Luciferian doctrine" to advance further | WM, pp.164–165 |
| 14 | Buzz Aldrin, Omar Bradley, Kit Carson, Winston Churchill, Henry Ford, Benjamin Franklin, Clark Gable, John Glenn, J. Edgar Hoover, Sam Houston, John Wayne, Duke Ellington, Cecil B. DeMille, etc. | Listed as famous Freemasons | WM reads list, p.173 |
| 15 | 16 US Presidents listed as Masons | Washington through Ford, plus Bush and Reagan | WM, p.173 |
| 16 | William Cooper himself | Claims former membership in "the Office of Naval Intelligence" | WC, p.166 |

**Notable checkability notes on people:**
- **Churchill** was a Mason (Initiated at Studholme Lodge, 1908) — true.
- **Truman** was a Grand Master of Missouri — true.
- **Stalin** as a 33rd-degree Mason — **no evidence whatsoever**; fabricated.
- **Bush** — no
